# forms-site

Covers the markup of every form moss draws: the one-line `:::subscribe` form (plain and with authored words), a subscribe form that asks questions (English and Traditional Chinese, with a pick-several group and an Other box), a members page's lead above its form, and a `:::form` request form with every field type and help text. `expected/` is the byte-for-byte record of that markup, so a change to how forms are drawn shows here.
